_README: Maps each 3-char tracker code to the matrix CLIENT NAMES (which must match the column headers in Start Billables.xlsx). The tools resolve names to columns at write-time using the 'NON BILLABLE' column as the divider between the billable section (left) and non-billable section (right), so columns can be inserted/moved without breaking anything. billableName = header for BILLABLE hours; nonBillableName = header for NON-BILLABLE hours; null = that client has no column of that type. Add a new code here; build-append.js errors on any unknown code.
